import Mathlib

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits

namespace CouniversalityAudit

universe u v w z

def edge {α : Type u} (a b : α) : (α × α) →₀ ℤ := by
  classical
  exact if a = b then 0 else Finsupp.single (a, b) 1

theorem edge_identity_iff {E : Type u} [PartialOrder E]
    (a b c : E) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    edge a c - edge a b = edge b c ↔ a = b ∨ b = c := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hn
    have habn : a ≠ b := fun he => hn (Or.inl he)
    have hbcn : b ≠ c := fun he => hn (Or.inr he)
    have hacn : a ≠ c := by
      intro he
      apply habn
      exact le_antisymm hab (by simpa [he] using hbc)
    have hc := congrArg (fun q : (E × E) →₀ ℤ => q (a, c)) h
    simp [edge, habn, hbcn, hacn, Ne.symm habn, Ne.symm hbcn,
      Finsupp.single_apply] at hc
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp [edge]

def normalized {α : Type u} (l : List α) : (List α) →₀ ℤ := by
  classical
  exact if l.Nodup then Finsupp.single l 1 else 0

theorem normalized_repeat {α : Type u} (pre post : List α) (a : α) :
    normalized (pre ++ a :: a :: post) = 0 := by
  classical
  simp [normalized, List.nodup_append]

theorem normalized_last_duplicate {α : Type u} (l : List α) (a : α) :
    normalized (l ++ [a, a]) = 0 := by
  exact normalized_repeat l [] a

def AppendControl {E : Type u} [LE E] (f g : E → E) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, x ≤ y → f x = g x ∨ g x = g y

theorem terminal_correction {E : Type u} [PartialOrder E]
    (f g : E → E) (hg : Monotone g) (hc : AppendControl f g)
    (l : List E) (u v : E)
    (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, x ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) :
    normalized (((l ++ [u]).map f) ++ [g v]) -
        normalized (((l ++ [u]).map f) ++ [g u]) =
      normalized ((l ++ [u, v]).map g) := by
  classical
  by_cases hlast : g u = g v
  · rw [hlast]
    simp [List.map_append, ← hlast, normalized_last_duplicate]
  · have hmap : (l ++ [u]).map f = (l ++ [u]).map g := by
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro x hx
      have hxu : x ≤ u := by
        rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
        · exact hl x hx
        · simpa using hx
      have hxv : x ≤ v := le_trans hxu huv
      rcases hc x v hxv with he | he
      · exact he
      · exfalso
        apply hlast
        apply le_antisymm (hg huv)
        simpa [← he] using hg hxu
    rw [hmap]
    simp [List.map_append, List.append_assoc, normalized_last_duplicate]

theorem sieve_constancy_implies_control {E : Type u} [PartialOrder E]
    (A : Set E) (hA : IsLowerSet A) (f g : E → E)
    (hold : ∀ x ∈ A, f x = g x)
    (hnew : ∀ x ∉ A, ∀ y ∉ A, g x = g y) :
    AppendControl f g := by
  intro x y hxy
  by_cases hx : x ∈ A
  · exact Or.inl (hold x hx)
  · have hy : y ∉ A := fun hy => hx (hA hxy hy)
    exact Or.inr (hnew x hx y hy)

theorem glue_along_adjunction
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {D : Type w} [Category.{z} D]
    {L : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} (adj : L ⊣ R)
    {A X B Y : C} {a : A ⟶ X} {i : A ⟶ B}
    {j : X ⟶ Y} {b : B ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPushout a i j b)
    (Z : D) (s : L.obj X ⟶ Z) (p : L.obj B ⟶ Z)
    (h : L.map a ≫ s = L.map i ≫ p) :
    ∃! q : L.obj Y ⟶ Z, L.map j ≫ q = s ∧ L.map b ≫ q = p := by
  let tx := (adj.homEquiv X Z) s
  let tb := (adj.homEquiv B Z) p
  have ht : a ≫ tx = i ≫ tb := by
    dsimp [tx, tb]
    rw [← adj.homEquiv_naturality_left, ← adj.homEquiv_naturality_left, h]
  let d := sq.desc tx tb ht
  refine ⟨(adj.homEquiv Y Z).symm d, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · rw [← adj.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm]
      change (adj.homEquiv X Z).symm (j ≫ sq.desc tx tb ht) = s
      rw [sq.inl_desc]
      exact (adj.homEquiv X Z).symm_apply_apply s
    · rw [← adj.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm]
      change (adj.homEquiv B Z).symm (b ≫ sq.desc tx tb ht) = p
      rw [sq.inr_desc]
      exact (adj.homEquiv B Z).symm_apply_apply p
  · intro q hq
    apply (adj.homEquiv Y Z).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    apply sq.hom_ext
    · rw [← adj.homEquiv_naturality_left, hq.1]
      exact (sq.inl_desc tx tb ht).symm
    · rw [← adj.homEquiv_naturality_left, hq.2]
      exact (sq.inr_desc tx tb ht).symm

#print axioms edge_identity_iff
#print axioms terminal_correction
#print axioms sieve_constancy_implies_control
#print axioms glue_along_adjunction

end CouniversalityAudit

end

statement_fidelity.text:
# Statement fidelity

`Main.lean` is an independent Lean 4.31 formalization of specified
algebraic and universal-property parts of the couniversality audit.
It is **not** a formalization of strict higher categories, the Gray
tensor, the Street nerve, weak homotopy equivalences, or the complete
couniversality theorem. It does not import the incompatible public
OpenAI development.

## Declarations

`CouniversalityAudit.edge` is the generator `(a,b)` of the free abelian
group on ordered pairs, except that it is zero when `a=b`.
`edge_identity_iff` quantifies over every partially ordered set and
every triple `a <= b <= c`. It proves
`[a,c] - [a,b] = [b,c]` if and only if `a=b` or `b=c`.
There is no bound on the poset or on its cardinality. Only weakly
increasing pairs are used in this interpretation.

`normalized` takes a list to its generator in the free abelian group
on all lists when it has no repeated entries, and to zero otherwise.
On the weakly increasing tuples in the mathematical proof, this is
exactly the usual normalized-simplex bracket. It is not a definition
of a differential, nor does the formalization assert that an arbitrary
unordered list is an ordered simplex.
`normalized_repeat` and `normalized_last_duplicate` prove the specified
repeated-tuple vanishings.

`AppendControl f g` means that for every comparable pair `x <= y`,
either `f(x)=g(x)` or `g(x)=g(y)`.
`terminal_correction` quantifies over every poset, monotone `g`,
every function `f` satisfying this control condition, every finite
list `l`, and every `u <= v`, assuming every entry of `l` is at most
`u`. It proves

```
[f(l),f(u),g(v)] - [f(l),f(u),g(u)]
  = [g(l),g(u),g(v)].
```

In the prism proof this is `B-B'=G`. There is no bound on list
length, so this is not finite testing of dimensions. Monotonicity of
`f` and `f <= g` are not needed for this isolated equality; those
additional hypotheses are needed in the mathematical proof to make
the displayed tuples positive ordered simplices.

`sieve_constancy_implies_control` proves, for every lower subset `A`,
that `f=g` on `A` and constancy of `g` on its complement imply
`AppendControl f g`. These are constructed consequences of the
manuscript's hypotheses, not new assumptions for the original prism.

`glue_along_adjunction` quantifies over arbitrary categories, an actual
adjunction `L : C -> D` left adjoint to `R`, an actual categorical
pushout `Y` of `X <- A -> B`, an arbitrary target `Z` in `D`, and
arbitrary compatible maps `s : L(X) -> Z`, `p : L(B) -> Z`.
It constructs the unique `q : L(Y) -> Z` restricting to `s,p`.
There is no monomorphism, freeness, cofibrancy, or dimension
restriction. It proves the universal-property mechanism used to glue
whole cylinders. It does **not** construct the particular
strict-category adjunction or its finite-dimensional restriction;
those are separate mathematical obligations in the report.

## Trust and limits

The source imports Mathlib and uses no custom axioms, `sorry`,
`admit`, or `native_decide`. The four main declarations print their
axiom dependencies. Kernel checking establishes these statements,
not the identification of their abstract objects with the full
manuscript construction.

The associated ledger claim for a compiler run must therefore be an
algebraic or universal-property claim, not `C_COUNIVERSAL`.
A compiling source cannot by itself close the categorical,
topological, literature, novelty, or independent-review obligations.
